$comment: Machine-readable form of the extracted Poki developer guide (docs/poki/*.md). Each rule is checked by `pnpm poki:audit` (scripts/poki-audit.mjs), which writes docs/poki/COMPLIANCE.md. verify.type: file | grep | grepAbsent | test | command | barrel | manual. `kind` mirrors the guide's force: requirement (enforced by the platform), recommendation, informational. `status`: satisfied | action (human/submission step) | deferred (documented, accepted) | informational.

rules.rule: Choose a web game engine deliberately (2D/3D + multiplayer needs) and understand player-hardware insights so the build stays compatible and performant.
rules.evidence: Engine decision + device baseline documented; the game uses Three.js with hand-rolled systems (see docs/poki/01-web-game-engines.md §Part 4).

rules.rule: Success on web depends on fast onboarding, high engagement strategies, and localization.
rules.evidence: 3-step play-signal onboarding, progression systems, and 12 locales.

rules.rule: Integrate monetization early so rewarded placements land at natural moments.
rules.evidence: Rewarded revive is part of the crash flow, with placement analytics.

rules.rule: Thumbnails are the primary acquisition surface; make them impactful.
rules.evidence: Spec-checked thumbnails in assets/submission/ + THB gate.

rules.rule: The guide is the starting point for optimising games for the web environment.
rules.evidence: This corpus.

rules.rule: Filter engines by required dimensions (2D/3D) and multiplayer support before deeper research.
rules.evidence: §Part 4 records the filter outcome for Sunbird.

rules.rule: Mobile web fit: prefer engines with touch support and small files — initial download < 5 MB, total < 8 MB.
rules.evidence: Portal zips gated at 8 MB; shipped size ≈0.7 MB.

rules.rule: Team fit: the engine must support collaborative work on the same project files; count per-seat licensing.
rules.evidence: MIT-licensed library + plain TypeScript modules + git: no per-seat cost, no binary project format.

rules.rule: Some engines are purpose-built for web performance; heavy engines need extra effort for web exports.
rules.evidence: Documented engine decision; no engine runtime ships.

rules.rule: Web success factors: mobile web optimisation, engine capabilities, team workflow.

verify.note: Reference material.

rules.evidence: See docs/poki/01-web-game-engines.md §Part 3.

rules.rule: Mobile first: prioritise mobile compatibility early, not as a late port.
rules.evidence: Mobile/tablet detection (UA + coarse pointer + narrow viewport) drives render tier, DPR and AI fidelity.

rules.rule: Keep it small: target an 8–10 MB game file for older hardware and slow connections.
rules.evidence: Procedural assets, self-hosted subset fonts, single-file build; zip gated < 8 MB.

rules.rule: Skip the menu: let first-time players reach gameplay without splash/title/level-select detours.
rules.evidence: One-screen entry with a single hero 'Fly now' action.

rules.rule: Loading screens must be visually engaging and include a progress bar.
rules.evidence: Inline zero-request boot screen with an animated mark and a progress bar driven by real boot stages.

rules.rule: Progressive loading: ship essential initial assets first, load the rest in the background.
rules.evidence: Interaction-first boot stages + idle-deferred work (BootProgress).

rules.rule: Safe beginner environment: simple early levels, gradual difficulty, prevent early death.
rules.evidence: Onboarding runs on forgiving terrain with launch assist; second-wind continue exists.

rules.rule: Gradual introduction: teach mechanics and controls over several levels to cut frontal load.
rules.evidence: One cue at a time (dive → soar → land), gated on real input.

rules.rule: Explain the game with visuals, not text walls; tutorials must not block gameplay.
rules.evidence: Gesture/icon cues that never take input away, localized across all locales.

rules.rule: Playtest recordings to fine-tune onboarding and drop-off.

verify.pattern: enables event tracking on the boot path

rules.evidence: First-run funnel is instrumented and pinned (boot-path event tracking + visible/interact pairing, poki-game-events.test.ts). The Playtest upload itself is a dashboard action.

rules.rule: Portrait vs landscape: portrait raises engagement ~6% and unlocks Gamebar Display ads; both orientations are supported.
rules.evidence: Portrait and landscape both playable: narrow-aspect camera pull-back, safe-area insets, HUD reflow; e2e covers phone portrait + landscape.

rules.rule: Accessibility: support both mouse and keyboard navigation.
rules.evidence: Full play with mouse-only, keyboard-only, touch-only or gamepad; menus are focus-managed DOM overlays.

rules.rule: Standardise controls: WASD or arrow keys for movement, space or return for primary menu actions.
rules.evidence: Dive accepts Space/WASD/arrows; Space+Return activate an overlay's primary action (OverlayNavigation).

rules.rule: Clear long-term goals in addition to short-term level goals.
rules.evidence: Skins with perks, trails, biomes, mastery, missions, collections, season pass, cups, ranked divisions.

rules.rule: Tune difficulty with an increasing scale from accessible starts to new mechanics.
rules.evidence: In-run ramps + campaign/mastery/rank progression.

rules.rule: Congratulate the player: celebrate milestones with visual and audio feedback.
rules.evidence: Confetti burst + jingle on personal bests, level-ups, chests and race wins; the results card carries a NEW BEST banner and the portal celebration hook fires when one exists.

rules.rule: Test it: find drop-off points to distinguish difficulty frustration from lost interest.
rules.evidence: Run outcome, placement visibility/interaction and economy events are all instrumented.

rules.rule: Integrate monetization early so rewarded video fits the natural game flow.
rules.evidence: Rewarded revive wired into the crash flow.

rules.rule: Engagement first: rewarded video performance follows engagement.
rules.evidence: Deep progression layer independent of ads.

rules.rule: Rewarded videos must be optional and never block core gameplay.
rules.evidence: Free restart and free 'let it sleep' paths always exist; no mode is ad-gated.

rules.rule: Every video-triggering element must be clearly labelled, accessible and transparent about the reward.
rules.evidence: Labelled button, aria-labelled, explicit reward wording.

rules.rule: Always provide a standard (non-ad) alternative to a rewarded option.
rules.evidence: e2e/results.spec.ts pins the standard and free options beside the rewarded one ('Let it sleep' always rendered).

rules.rule: Standard and rewarded options appear simultaneously.
rules.evidence: All three options render in one pass; nothing gates the ad behind a wizard step.

rules.rule: The standard button is at least as large as the rewarded button and sits above or beside it.

verify.note: CSS audit: .primary-btn (18px type, 12px padding, full width) renders above .soft-btn.wide (14px, 10px padding); pinned by HUD test.

rules.evidence: src/game/HUD.ts renderContinue markup order.

rules.rule: Rewarded buttons must not be green.

verify.note: Rewarded CTA uses the warm-neutral .soft-btn surface; the game's action colour is orange and gold is reserved for the Gold pass.

rules.evidence: src/index.css .soft-btn

rules.rule: Reward buttons carry a prominent clapperboard icon.
rules.evidence: 🎬 present on the rewarded continue button and verified in the shipped bundle.

rules.rule: One video per reward, maximum.
rules.evidence: A single grant site; the returned boolean is the only reward source.

rules.rule: Confirm rewards immediately (animation/sound) and apply them automatically.
rules.evidence: Run resumes in place with a jingle, coin toast and slow-mo restore - no menu detour.

rules.rule: No reward when the ad fails or is blocked; handle it silently.
rules.evidence: false/rejected break grants nothing, offers fallbacks, and never mentions ad blocking.

rules.rule: No ad-timer manipulation; the platform decides ad availability.
rules.evidence: adTimer/shouldShowInterstitial/adsLeftToday are local-build-only; portal builds ask the SDK.

rules.rule: Never reward-wall core gameplay.
rules.evidence: Every mode is reachable with earned coins or for free.

rules.rule: No pushy prompts: non-ad options in primary positions, no invasive rewarded CTAs.

verify.note: One rewarded placement in the whole game, shown only after crash; standard option is the primary-styled button.

rules.evidence: src/game/HUD.ts renderContinue

rules.rule: Helping hand: revives, skips, hints, boosts to reduce drop-off.
rules.evidence: Rewarded revive.

rules.rule: In-game economy: let players spend earned currency or watch a video for the same reward.
rules.evidence: Coins-or-video choice on the continue screen, single currency.

rules.rule: Customization: rewarded video can unlock cosmetics and replayability.
rules.evidence: Skins/trails/biomes are earned with in-game coins (no real money in portal builds).

rules.rule: Prefer dynamic, context-specific rewarded opportunities over static always-on buttons.
rules.evidence: ContinueOffer picks framing from run context (near-best, streak at risk, momentum) and only exists after a crash.

rules.rule: Use temporary or seasonal content to lift long-term retention.
rules.evidence: Season pass, weekly cups, festival events, rotating daily/weekly challenges.

rules.rule: Monitor balance: ad rewards must not distort progression; consider limits.
rules.evidence: One continue per crash; economy faucets are audited (see POKI_COMPLIANCE_AUDIT.md fix log F5/F8).

rules.rule: No fake ad affordances: nothing may look like an ad surface unless it is one.

verify.note: Removed in the compliance pass: the 'Ad Multiplier' card and the wheel's video-option button were deleted; the only TV/clapperboard surface is the real rewarded break.

rules.evidence: POKI_COMPLIANCE_AUDIT.md F6

rules.rule: Localization is essential for engagement outside English-speaking regions.
rules.evidence: 12 shipped locales.

rules.rule: Centralize all text into a single file format before translating.
rules.evidence: One barrel file with keyed entries (sourceText + meta + placeholders + translations); lookup via t()/useTranslations().

rules.rule: Prioritise localization for text-carrying genres/mechanics.
rules.evidence: Tutorial, shop, settings and results copy are all in the barrel.

rules.rule: Phase 1: EFIGS + Turkish. Phase 2: CJK. Phase 3: pt-BR + Russian.
rules.evidence: All phase-1 and phase-3 locales ship, with the phase-2 CJK pair present (Korean is the remaining optional locale).

rules.rule: Detect the browser language and serve it; a manual selector should exist too.
rules.evidence: Boot-time navigator.language matching, persisted choice (private-mode safe), manual selector in Settings, RTL direction handling.

rules.rule: A high-quality thumbnail is essential for attracting players.
rules.evidence: assets/submission/sunbird-thumbnail-1024.png rendered from the game's own palette and mid-dive pose.

rules.rule: The thumbnail must accurately reflect the game's content.

verify.note: Thumbnail uses the game's sky/sun/ridge palette and the player's bird in the pose seen in the first five seconds.

rules.evidence: assets/submission/sunbird-thumbnail-1024.png

rules.rule: Embrace simplicity: one clear foreground object.

verify.note: Single hero subject (bird) over a two-layer background; no clutter or screenshot chrome.

rules.evidence: assets/submission/sunbird-thumbnail-1024.png

rules.rule: Keep a series visually consistent across thumbnails.

verify.note: One palette and hero pose reused across icon sizes, store card and video frame.

rules.evidence: public/icons/ + assets/submission/

rules.rule: Full-bleed square, minimum 628 x 628 px.
rules.evidence: 1024x1024, square, full-bleed.

rules.rule: Do not cut corners: rounded corners are applied by the platform mask.
rules.evidence: Gate asserts corner pixels are opaque and painted (no baked rounding, border or letterbox).

rules.rule: Details and typography must stay legible when scaled down.
rules.evidence: Gate downsamples to 128 px and requires the subject/background contrast to survive; thumbnail carries no typography by design.

rules.rule: High contrast; avoid colours close to the Poki Playground background #83FFE7.
rules.evidence: Gate rejects a dominant colour within the threshold of #83FFE7 and requires a minimum luminance spread.

rules.rule: Static thumbnail for the player-fit test; animated 3-5 s gameplay loop before global release.
rules.evidence: Animated 3-5 s gameplay loop captured from the shipping folder by scripts/capture-animated-thumbnail.mjs (628x628 GIF); the static thumbnails are gated by verify:thumbnail.

rules.rule: Keep delivered image weight sane (Inspector warns on heavy images).
rules.evidence: Gate enforces a maximum encoded size per thumbnail.

rules.rule: The Player Device Report gives daily-updated insights into player hardware and software.

verify.note: Reference: the platform publishes this; the game consumes the implications.

rules.evidence: docs/poki/07-player-device-report.md

rules.rule: Report data comes from a random sample of 100M players and follows Poki's privacy policies.

verify.note: Reference. Sunbird's own device_profile telemetry is aggregate capability data only - no PII, no persistent identifier.

rules.evidence: src/sdk/device-report.ts (no identifiers emitted)

rules.rule: Code to the measured baseline: know the runtime's capabilities and pick tiers from them.
rules.evidence: detectDeviceProfile() probes every dimension the report lists and derives a render tier.

rules.rule: Capture OS and browser distribution inputs.
rules.evidence: userAgentData first, UA fallback; reported once per session.

rules.rule: Capture CPU core counts and size quality tiers accordingly.
rules.evidence: Low-core devices resolve to the lite tier (shadows off, capped DPR, reduced AI fidelity).

rules.rule: Capture aspect ratios and device pixel ratios; never render more pixels than needed.
rules.evidence: DPR capped (never above 2x) and reduced automatically under load; aspect feeds the camera rig.

rules.rule: Know audio format support.
rules.evidence: Opus/AAC/MP3/WebM/FLAC/WAV probed; the audio path is a procedural WebAudio synth, so no asset format can fail - the probe drives the no-WebAudio fallback.

rules.rule: Know WASM, WebRTC, WebP and WakeLock support and gate features on it.
rules.evidence: WebRTC gates the P2P transport; WakeLock keeps mobile screens awake during runs; WebP checked before image output; WASM probed for the multiplayer client path.

rules.rule: Know WebGPU and WebGL version/extension support.
rules.evidence: WebGL 1/2 + renderer string + max texture size probed before renderer creation; WebGPU availability reported for future renderer decisions.

rules.rule: Know AI feature availability (translator, language model, summarizer, detector).
rules.evidence: Probed and reported only; no AI-generated player-visible content ships (see REQ-34).

rules.rule: The Inspector evaluates a web build against the platform's success factors.

verify.note: Submission-time tool run.

rules.evidence: docs/poki/08-game-dev-tools.md

rules.rule: The build must survive the Inspector's mobile and technical-optimisation passes (no external resources, no console errors, sane image weights).
rules.evidence: audit-zips.mjs sweeps the bundle for external URLs, banned markers and lifecycle signals.

rules.rule: Uploadable as a folder with index.html at the root, working from any sub-path.
rules.evidence: `pnpm build:poki` GENERATES `poki-upload/` (index.html at the root); `pnpm verify:upload` (ROOT-01…ROOT-06) asserts the folder and the zip both carry a root index.html, that the folder is current with `dist-poki/`, and that it holds only uploadable files — the failure mode behind the reported "missing index.html" upload. Runbook: docs/poki/UPLOAD.md.

rules.rule: Netlib is a WebRTC-datachannel P2P library for web games.
rules.evidence: Client implemented behind a code-split.

rules.rule: Netlib is usable whether or not the game is hosted on Poki.

verify.note: Availability note.

rules.evidence: docs/poki/08-game-dev-tools.md

rules.rule: Feature-detect WebRTC and keep a non-P2P path when using Netlib.
rules.evidence: P2P is selected only when the build targets Poki AND RTCPeerConnection/crypto are present (PokiMpUtils.isPokiMultiplayerAvailable); WebSocket and local paths remain for every other build.

rules.rule: AUDS stores user-generated content and returns shareable codes, enabling non-real-time multiplayer.
rules.evidence: Implemented: score boards, ghost shares, per-user sync, a public pilot directory (src/game/PilotDirectory.ts — code-only lookup, one record per pilot, no presence claims) and — for non-real-time multiplayer — run share codes (src/sdk/auds.ts, src/game/SharedRun.ts: publish a run, race a friend's code, count plays through the public _increment endpoint).

rules.rule: AUDS is exclusive to Poki-hosted games and needs a live game id, so it cannot be a dependency of portable builds.
rules.evidence: ROOT-10 proves the shipped html carries the Poki game id with AUDS live; isolation:check proves no non-Poki edition can reach auds.poki.io.

rules.rule: Scale to 640x360, 836x470 and 1031x580 (plus real devices) with no crop or scroll.
rules.evidence: e2e asserts canvas coverage, visible menu/lobby and zero page errors at each size.

rules.rule: Run inside a cross-origin iframe: no top-level navigation, window.open, dialogs, or console errors.
rules.evidence: Rejection guard installed before anything else; overlay-only UI; share flow uses the platform share API.

rules.rule: Fully playable in incognito / with storage blocked.
rules.evidence: Storage facade: localStorage -> sessionStorage -> in-memory, canary-probed.

rules.rule: Initial download under ~5 MB, total under ~8 MB.
rules.evidence: Zip gate at 8 MB; measured ≈0.7 MB.

rules.rule: No service worker or manifest inside portal builds.
rules.evidence: Manifest link stripped at packaging; boot.ts skips registration entirely for portal targets.

rules.rule: Fixed non-scrolling page with the canvas filling the viewport; portrait and landscape supported.
rules.evidence: body/#root fixed inset:0 overflow:hidden; renderer resize on viewport change.

rules.rule: Lifecycle order init -> gameLoadingStart -> gameLoadingFinished, each phase marker once.
rules.evidence: PokiAdapter.loadingFinished() is one-shot; gameLoadingStart fires once right after init; and the entry-point loading-screen failsafe routes through the live adapter instead of the raw SDK global, so it cannot add a second gameLoadingFinished on a healthy boot (it used to, 1.5 s after window load — found by e2e/poki-artifact.spec.ts, pinned by platform-failsafe.test.ts).

rules.rule: gameplayStart on real play start, gameplayStop on stop; never duplicated or inverted.
rules.evidence: GameplayEventSink dedupes every emission and suppresses stale phase replays; the shipping artifact is now recorded in a real browser (pnpm test:artifact) and the sequence is asserted to contain no consecutive duplicate gameplay phase.

rules.rule: Pause/unpause order: gameplayStop -> commercialBreak -> gameplayStart.
rules.evidence: Both resume call sites (button, ESC/P) route through the commercial break.

rules.rule: Game events: one start per attempt, then exactly one of complete or fail.
rules.evidence: runOutcome resets to fail at run start and is only set to complete on the goal-reached branch.

rules.rule: Rewarded placements emit visible when shown and interact when chosen.
rules.evidence: measure('button','continue-ad','visible'|'interact') on the continue screen.

rules.rule: Mute audio and disable input for the whole ad break.
rules.evidence: beginPortalAd/endPortalAd mute audio and gate input around the break.

rules.rule: Work when the SDK is unavailable: boot anyway, never block on the portal.
rules.evidence: SDK load races a hard timeout; init rejection is swallowed; a safety timer dismisses the portal loader.

rules.rule: No in-app purchases on the platform and no UI implying them.
rules.evidence: Packaging scrubs payment markers; verify-portal rejects stripe literals; portal builds use coin-only progression.

rules.rule: No secondary spendable currencies.
rules.evidence: One spendable currency (coins); VIP/Gold are statuses. The dead VIP-coin ad flow was removed.

rules.rule: No third-party ad systems.
rules.evidence: Bundle sweep asserts the absence of non-platform ad literals.

rules.rule: No ad-timer or cooldown manipulation.
rules.evidence: Local ad pacing logic is excluded from portal builds.

rules.rule: External links only through the platform API; portal builds should have none.
rules.evidence: Zero external links in portal bundles (og:url stripped, store links scrubbed).

rules.rule: All-ages content: no violence, sexual content, gambling, substances, fear or bullying.

verify.note: Family-friendly bird flight; no combat, no gore, no casino framing (the lucky wheel is a free daily gift, not a paid spin), no substances, no chat.

rules.evidence: POKI_COMPLIANCE_AUDIT.md C12

rules.rule: No chat in multiplayer surfaces; emotes are the recommended alternative.
rules.evidence: Portal editions ship NO chat: SQUAD_CHAT=false in edition.poki/crazy/generic.ts removes the club chat box, its input and the chat promise from the menu copy, Game/Squad refuse the send, and the polling loop never runs. Enforced by the PORTAL_FORBIDDEN_MARKERS table in scripts/portal-markers.mjs (checked by verify-portal, audit-zips and verify-upload ROOT-07); emotes are the sanctioned alternative and are now reachable in every race state (src/game/__tests__/emote-ui.test.ts).

rules.rule: No PII collection; platform identity is display-only.
rules.evidence: Passive getUser() only, never persisted; no email/social login.

rules.rule: Originality: art, UI, mechanics, characters, audio and name must be the developer's own.

verify.note: Procedural biomes, custom UI, original bird/characters, procedural score; no third-party art or audio.

rules.evidence: POKI_COMPLIANCE_AUDIT.md C13

rules.rule: AI-assisted production: no watermarks or prompt text; process documentable on request.

verify.note: No AI-generated asset files ship (art is procedural, audio is synthesized); production history is the git log.

rules.evidence: Bundle sweep for watermark/prompt strings (audit-zips.mjs)

rules.rule: External resources policy: prefer zero external requests; bundle assets and avoid CDNs.
rules.evidence: Full external-URL inventory of the bundle; fonts self-hosted and inlined.

rules.rule: Identity is passive: never force a login at boot.

verify.note: login() is deliberately not called at boot (Poki's login reloads the page on first use); getUser() is passive with a local fallback name.

rules.evidence: src/sdk/poki.ts getIdentity()

rules.rule: Platform tokens are short-lived and must be verified server-side immediately, never stored.
rules.evidence: getIapToken() returns the token for immediate verification; nothing persists it.

rules.rule: A player who is not signed in must still play the full game.
rules.evidence: Local save and local boards are the default; platform identity only decorates the profile.

rules.rule: Revenue split: 100% on search/owned traffic, 50/50 on platform-driven traffic.

verify.note: Business term; nothing to implement.

rules.evidence: docs/poki/09-platform-requirements.md

rules.rule: The submitted build is web-exclusive: no store build that double-serves the Poki artifact.
rules.evidence: Separate artifacts per portal with distinct hashes; the Poki zip carries no store links, and scripts/audit-zips.mjs + verify-portal.mjs fail on ANY foreign portal marker (scripts/portal-markers.mjs).

rules.rule: Release flow: folder upload -> Inspector QA -> player-fit test -> web-fit test -> review.
rules.evidence: Inspector QA modules mapped to gates: folder/root index (verify:upload), External Resources (audit:zips), Image Optimization (verify:thumbnail); scaling and mobile are covered by test:orientation and test:mobile in `pnpm gate`.

rules.rule: Web-fit metrics: C2P (click-to-play), CTR (thumbnail), time on page.

verify.note: C2P is minimised by the sub-1 MB boot and immediate first frame; CTR by the specification-compliant thumbnail; time-on-page by the daily/weekly retention loops.

rules.evidence: docs/poki/09-platform-requirements.md

rules.rule: Do not place HUD under the mobile platform pill; use movePill() to relocate it.
rules.evidence: Pill moved clear of the flight HUD at SDK boot.

rules.rule: Player-authored text is limited to the pilot's own display name: no chat system, no personal-data collection, and the name is moderated before it can be broadcast or stored, because it reaches other players (netlib rosters, name tags) and a public leaderboard.
rules.evidence: Poki forbids chat systems and personal-data collection (external-resources policy: 'Chat systems aren't allowed', 'Games must not collect personal information', 'no email-based logins'), which is SQUAD_CHAT=false — the chat UI is not in the bundle. It does not forbid a chosen display name, so edition.poki.ts sets CUSTOM_PILOT_NAMES=true and the safety work moves to moderation: every write goes through src/game/pilotNameModeration.ts (shape + contact guard + NFKD/leit/homoglyph normalisation + blocklist + a safe-word allowlist so 'Cockpit'/'Classic'/'Assassin' are not caught by their own substrings), asserted by pilot-name-moderation.test.ts (95 cases) and gated at both write paths in Game.ts. crazy/generic keep CUSTOM_PILOT_NAMES=false (no filter there).

rules.rule: No offer to remove or disable ads, and no ad-frequency claim in a portal paywall.
rules.evidence: GOLD's "No sponsored breaks, ever" bullet is emitted only when edition SELL_AD_REMOVAL is true (direct build); portal bundles fold the ternary to [] and contain no such string. Portal builds never inject their own interstitials (dueAd is gated on portalEnabled()), so the claim was untrue there as well as forbidden.

rules.rule: Portal bundles must contain no ad-removal copy, and no portal may ship a name surface it does not moderate (bundle-level enforcement of REQ-20 and the pilot-name policy).
rules.evidence: PORTAL_FORBIDDEN_MARKERS rejects /No sponsored breaks/i and ad-removal phrasing in every portal zip; the direct build keeps both (dist/assets/Game-*.js). data-ref="pilotName" is a FOREIGN marker for crazy/generic (CUSTOM_PILOT_NAMES=false there, so a typed field in those bundles means the flag regressed) and an allowed surface on Poki, which moderates it.

rules.rule: A portal build must not describe or count ad breaks it does not schedule — the platform owns ad frequency.
rules.evidence: The Account screen's "Sponsored breaks respect a hard cap: N left today" line is now gated on portalName === "none"; e2e/portal-policy.spec.ts (pnpm test:policy) boots poki-upload/ in a real browser and scans the rendered text of 17 reachable screens for ad-removal/ad-schedule copy on desktop and phone.

rules.rule: A portal build must issue no request that can fail on the host origin (no relative calls to absent backends).
rules.evidence: Squad.load() returned early only on abort/live/loading, so with VITE_SOCIAL_URL blanked it fetched a relative /register against the host origin — a 404 plus a console error the moment a player opened Squad on Poki. It now also bails when API is empty; the policy spec fails on any response >= 400 while walking every menu screen.

rules.rule: The SDK is loaded from the platform CDN in the page head; never bundled or re-hosted.
rules.evidence: scripts/package-portal.mjs injects the exact CDN script tag into the Poki head; ROOT-08 + the analytics test assert it survives packaging.

rules.rule: init() runs at start and the game continues on both then() and catch().
rules.evidence: bootstrapSdk() awaits init() inside a try; SDK_LOAD_TIMEOUT_MS and the loading failsafe keep a blocked CDN playable.

rules.rule: gameLoadingFinished() fires when loading completes, exactly once.
rules.evidence: One-shot flag in PokiAdapter.loadingFinished(); the entry-point failsafe routes through the same adapter.

rules.rule: gameplayStart()/gameplayStop() mark play and its halt, never repeating the same phase.
rules.evidence: Every phase change funnels through GameplayEventSink (src/game/GameplayEvents.ts), which suppresses consecutive duplicates.

rules.rule: commercialBreak() fires at natural stops as the player heads back into gameplay.
rules.evidence: Result/continue/pause transitions route through PlatformAdapter.commercialBreak().

rules.rule: Audio is muted and input disabled for the duration of a break, restored afterwards.
rules.evidence: beginPortalAd()/endPortalAd() silence audio and lock input; restore never depends on the pause callback firing.

rules.rule: A break that does not interrupt gameplay carries no stop/start pair.

verify.pattern: No gameplay event is sent here on purpose

rules.evidence: Documented and implemented in beginPortalAd(); pinned by the analytics test.

rules.rule: rewardedBreak() rewards only on true, after telling the player an ad is coming.
rules.evidence: The boolean gates the reward; the offer card is labelled with the 🎬 ad path beside a non-ad alternative.

rules.rule: A rewarded break resets the platform's commercial ad timer.

verify.note: Platform-side behaviour; the game schedules no ads of its own.

rules.evidence: No internal ad timer exists (REQ-21), so the platform's timer is the only one.

rules.rule: Space/arrow keys and wheel must not scroll the host page.
rules.evidence: installPageScrollGuards() is wired in Game boot and detached on dispose.

rules.rule: Shareable links use shareableURL() and are read back with getURLParam().
rules.evidence: PokiAdapter.share() prefers the SDK URL builder and only degrades when the SDK is absent.

rules.rule: External navigation goes through openExternalLink() — the game frame never navigates away.
rules.evidence: The Settings privacy link routes through platform.openExternalLink().

rules.rule: movePill(topPercent, topPx) keeps the mobile pill clear of the UI; topPercent is 0–50.
rules.evidence: Boot nudges to (50,-4) then (0,56) once the HUD exists — below the daylight meter, still above 50%.

rules.rule: Pill is 46x62 below 1211px wide and 92x64 at 1211px and up.

verify.note: Platform-drawn element; sizing is informational for layout decisions.

rules.evidence: The HUD keeps the top-left band clear on both pill widths.

rules.rule: The build is uploaded as a folder with index.html at the root and its event log checked in the Inspector.
rules.evidence: Folder shape is ROOT-01..ROOT-10 (index.html at the root, no wrapping directory, uploadable files only). The event-log sequences are pinned by src/game/__tests__/poki-analytics.test.ts; the Inspector walk confirms the same log.

rules.rule: gameLoadingFinished() is required to track loading and C2P.

verify.note: Tracked by SDK-03.

rules.evidence: Fired once per boot.

rules.rule: gameplayStart() = player starts interacting; gameplayStop() = gameplay halts.
rules.evidence: The sink is the single emitter of both phases.

rules.rule: Signal commercial opportunities liberally at natural stops; the platform decides when an ad shows.
rules.evidence: Breaks are requested at every natural halt (death, results exit, pause return).

rules.rule: Startup order is gameLoadingFinished() then gameplayStart().
rules.evidence: The stub-SDK test asserts the boot order.

rules.rule: Death/next-level/pause sequence is stop → commercialBreak → start.
rules.evidence: Pause→resume is asserted as commercialBreak start/end then gameplayStart.

rules.rule: Revive sequence is stop → rewardedBreak → start.
rules.evidence: Revive path asserted with the rewarded break.

rules.rule: Non-interrupting ads need no stop/start pair.
rules.evidence: Documented in beginPortalAd()'s comment and enforced by the sink.

rules.rule: No consecutive duplicate phases and no gameplay phase while an ad is on screen.
rules.evidence: The analytics test asserts zero gameplay events between break start and end.

rules.rule: The Inspector Event Log is the acceptance surface for the sequences.
rules.evidence: The documented sequence (gameplayStop -> commercialBreak -> gameplayStart, and the rewarded revive) is asserted in-process by poki-analytics.test.ts and observed end-to-end on the shipping artifact by e2e/poki-artifact.spec.ts.

rules.rule: Event tracking is switched on at boot, or no measure() checkpoint is recorded.
rules.evidence: Called right after init({submitScore}) inside its own try.

rules.rule: measure() uses short, stable category/what/action values.
rules.evidence: run/<mode>/start + outcome, button/<placement>/visible + interact, reward/<placement>/granted.

rules.rule: '/' and '^' must not appear in any measure() value.
rules.evidence: Source-level scan of every measure() call site plus the two dynamic value definitions.

rules.rule: Progress events pair start with exactly one of complete/fail, same category and what.
rules.evidence: The settlement path sends one outcome per attempt.

rules.rule: Interaction events pair visible with interact for the same category/what.
rules.evidence: Pinned by the game-events test (visible count >= interact count).

rules.rule: measure() must not duplicate ad impressions or completions.

verify.pattern: rewarded bonus card is on the recap

rules.evidence: Only the offer UI is measured; ad playback is tracked by the ad calls themselves.

rules.rule: Rewarded placements are measured per placement.
rules.evidence: Placement labels ('continue-ad-<kind>') keep offers comparable across contexts.

rules.rule: Custom events cover milestones and choices that fit no pattern.
rules.evidence: reward/<placement>/granted records the milestone.

rules.rule: new Network(<game-id>) then create() a lobby or join(code) it.
rules.evidence: Host creates, guest joins by code; both wrapped behind the game's NetTransport interface.

rules.rule: Real-time state on the unreliable channel; critical events on reliable.
rules.evidence: 15 Hz unreliable state + reliable hello/start/place events.

rules.rule: WebRTC is feature-detected and a non-WebRTC path exists.
rules.evidence: isPokiMultiplayerAvailable() gates the Netlib client; net-transport.poki.ts falls back to the WebSocket client.

rules.rule: The UI says whether the player is in a live room or a local/AI fallback.
rules.evidence: HUD status + race screen state the live/local truth; local rivals are labelled AI.

rules.rule: A dropped connection must not end the session; degrade to the local flock.
rules.evidence: Reconnect + seat preservation in PokiNetlibClient; MassRace keeps flying the local squadron otherwise.

rules.rule: Netlib is loaded lazily so it never lands in the boot path.
rules.evidence: One shared dynamic import (loadNetlib) is awaited by createNetTransport and warmed by prewarmNetTransport: the library is never in the boot path, and never in a non-Poki bundle.

rules.rule: A Netlib build must not contain another platform's transport names or endpoints.
rules.evidence: Per-target transport module swap + isolation check.

rules.rule: Lobby codes are short and unambiguous to read aloud.
rules.evidence: No 0/O/1/I alphabet, five characters, shared with the WebSocket transport.

rules.rule: POST …/<key> creates an entry from {data, values}; values accepts string|number|boolean.

verify.note: API shape; implemented in src/sdk/auds.ts.

rules.evidence: Create payloads keep values scalar.

rules.rule: The create secret is returned once and must be stored if the entry will ever change.
rules.evidence: Secrets are stored per entry; public score rows deliberately retain none (immutable).

rules.rule: List supports q=, sort=/-sort=, includedata and limit (1–100).
rules.evidence: Boards query the public sorted list with a limit.

rules.rule: Public counters use POST …/_increment?key=<k>, key must contain 'count', no secret.
rules.evidence: Shared-run plays are counted through the public counter endpoint.

rules.rule: Published content is public: payloads from the network must be validated before use.
rules.evidence: Leaderboard/SharedRun/GhostNet validate, clamp and truncate every network payload before rendering.

rules.rule: AUDS is Poki-only; no other edition may reach auds.poki.io.
rules.evidence: Gated on VITE_POKI_GAME_ID and asserted by pnpm isolation:check.

rules.rule: getUser() is called after load and every state (signed in, out, opted out) is handled.
rules.evidence: Adoption runs after boot; a null or throwing getUser() leaves the generated call sign in place.

rules.rule: login() is only called from a user interaction, never automatically on load.
rules.evidence: Only the Account screen's Sign in button reaches signInToPortal().

rules.rule: getToken() tokens are short-lived (~1 min) and must not be stored or reused.
rules.evidence: No backend needs the token, so the build never requests, stores or transmits one.

rules.rule: Local-only data is prefixed poki_ignore so cloud gamesaves skip it.
rules.evidence: physicalKey() maps board/ghost/journal/squad caches, AUDS secrets and the probe onto poki_ignore.*; reads migrate legacy keys.

rules.rule: The cloud save payload must stay under 1 MB gzipped.
rules.evidence: The synced set is the small progress/settings blob; large or device-specific data is ignored by construction.

rules.rule: Synced state must be safe to receive from another device.
rules.evidence: Per-device identifiers, recordings and caches live outside the synced set.

rules.rule: Inspector debug mode returns a static TestUser with a placeholder avatar.

verify.note: The Account screen renders whatever getUser() returns.

rules.evidence: TestUser renders as an ordinary signed-in account.

rules.rule: Upload a web build: folder with index.html at the root, working on desktop, mobile and tablet.
rules.evidence: poki-upload/ root index.html + responsive layout gates.

rules.rule: Thumbnail: full-bleed square >=628px, one subject, minimal text, high contrast, not near #83FFE7.
rules.evidence: THB gate measures size, bleed, corner mask, contrast, 128px legibility and weight.

rules.rule: Suggested categories: up to four chosen for genuine fit.
rules.evidence: Four categories chosen for fit and recorded in SUBMISSION.md (Multiplayer, Flappy-style, Racing, Popular); pasting them into the dashboard is the submission step.

rules.rule: A live privacy policy page is required before an external service can be approved.
rules.evidence: Self-contained policy page shipped with the standalone deploy; VITE_PRIVACY_URL can point at another host.

rules.rule: The privacy policy must also be linked from inside the game.
rules.evidence: Settings links it through platform.openExternalLink().

rules.rule: Dashboard description and engine field describe the game and the tech.
rules.evidence: Description and engine field prepared in SUBMISSION.md (engine: three-js); pasting them into the dashboard is the submission step.

rules.rule: External resources are requested in Settings → CSP; assets are bundled, not fetched from CDNs.
rules.evidence: Bundled fonts/images + the portal external-URL gate.

rules.rule: No in-game chat systems; emoji/quick messages are the sanctioned alternative.
rules.evidence: The chat UI is not in the portal bundle at all; emotes remain.

rules.rule: No external account systems and no collection of personal information.
rules.evidence: No email/social login in any portal build: identity comes from Poki's own getUser() (docs/poki/15-user-accounts.md), and the null/throwing case simply keeps the generated call sign. A typed pilot name is allowed, but CONTACT in src/game/pilotNameModeration.ts rejects anything shaped like an address, link, @handle or long digit run, so a public leaderboard cannot be used to publish contact details.

rules.rule: Content must stay family-friendly (no violence, gambling, adult or scary themes).

verify.note: Game content: birds, islands, weather; currency earned only by flying.

rules.evidence: Reviewed against the content list; nothing to remove.

rules.rule: Controls offer alternatives so players who cannot use WASD are not excluded.
rules.evidence: Pointer drag, touch drag, keyboard and auto-glide all steer; menus are mouse/touch/keyboard navigable.

rules.rule: Player fit test: 500 players; healthy = 3 min+ average and >=25% over 3 min.

verify.note: Run after the thumbnail is uploaded; requires 10 playtest recordings watched first.

rules.evidence: Target metric for the first fit test.

rules.rule: Web fit test weights CTR, average time on page and C2P equally; C2P comes from the first gameplayStart().

verify.note: C2P work already landed: portal editions skip the name screen and boot straight to play.

rules.evidence: Measured by the platform.

rules.rule: Web exclusivity: the same game may not be published on other web portals or aggregators.

verify.note: Separate per-target artifacts; the exclusivity decision is a publishing choice.

rules.evidence: Kept as a build/publish policy rather than a code fork.

rules.rule: Baseline signals: quality, player fit, and tech (load time, frame rate, file size).
rules.evidence: 1.78 MB single-file build, adaptive quality tiers, measured device profile.

rules.rule: Beyond the baseline: originality, depth, first impression, cross-device feel, room to grow.

verify.note: Documented in REBUILD_REPORT.md (30 tracks, seasons, wings, daily goals, endless/solo/race).

rules.evidence: Feature depth is tracked in the rebuild report.
